title: Zeroserve: A zero-config web server you can script with eBPF
summary: Zeroserve is a zero-configuration web server that leverages eBPF (Extended Berkeley Packet Filter) for dynamic scripting and packet-level customization, allowing developers to modify HTTP behavior without traditional config files or restart cycles.
problem_solved: Eliminates complex configuration files and static web server setups by enabling real-time, scriptable HTTP handling directly at the kernel/network layer.
why_valuable: Combines the simplicity of zero-config deployment with the power of eBPF for hot-reloadable, fine-grained request manipulation without service interruption.
